scientific_integrity: Analytic all-finite-tree proof; supporting 1590 exact rational finite-permutation checks are not a replacement for the proof. A closely related indexed historical record could not be inspected in full, and no independent validation was performed.
scientific_limitations: Optimality of source–sink orders is proved for sufficiently weak tree-dependent coupling, not for every SPD coupling. One exact coordinate sweep and isotropic initial covariance only; no claims for cycles, arbitrary initial covariance, long-run rates, or finite explicit coupling thresholds. Historical priority requires independent comparison.
title: Alternating one-sweep Gauss–Seidel orders on weighted trees: a universal fourth-order penalty
